description: This file defines a class 'Agent_SeqAgents' implementing an agent node with methods for initialization, creating agents, and handling messages, including state updates and tool invocation logic within a sequential agent framework.

classes.name: Agent_SeqAgents
classes.description: Implements a sequential agent node with methods for initialization, creating agents, and message handling, including state updates and tool invocation.

classes.name: ToolNode
classes.description: A class extending RunnableCallable to handle tool invocation and message processing within the agent framework.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the agent node with provided configuration, setting up prompts, tools, and agent parameters.

methods.name: createAgent
methods.description: Creates an agent with specified prompts, tools, and configurations, returning an executor or sequence.

methods.name: agentNode
methods.description: Executes the agent, processes the response, and handles state updates and message formatting.

methods.name: getReturnOutput
methods.description: Generates the output for state updates based on the agent's response and configuration.

methods.name: convertCustomMessagesToBaseMessages
methods.description: Converts string messages into HumanMessage instances with additional context.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs the tool node, invoking tools and generating messages based on the last AI message.
